scripts.build: npm run docs:openapi && npm run docs:llms && tsc -b && vite build && vite build --config vite.client.config.ts
scripts.docs:openapi: vite build --ssr scripts/generate-openapi.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/openapi --logLevel error && node node_modules/.cache/openapi/generate-openapi.js
scripts.docs:llms: vite build --ssr scripts/generate-llms.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/llms --logLevel error && node node_modules/.cache/llms/generate-llms.js
scripts.test:config: vite build --ssr scripts/tests/config.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/test-config --logLevel error && node node_modules/.cache/test-config/config.js
scripts.test:api: vite build --ssr scripts/tests/api.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/test-api --logLevel error && node node_modules/.cache/test-api/api.js
scripts.test:routes: npm run docs:openapi && vite build --ssr scripts/tests/routes.tsx --outDir node_modules/.cache/test-routes --logLevel error && node node_modules/.cache/test-routes/routes.js
scripts.test:dist: vite build --ssr scripts/tests/dist.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/test-dist --logLevel error && node node_modules/.cache/test-dist/dist.js
scripts.test:serve: vite build --ssr scripts/tests/serve.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/test-serve --logLevel error && node node_modules/.cache/test-serve/serve.js
scripts.tests: npm run test:config && npm run test:api && npm run test:routes && npm run build && npm run test:dist && npm run test:serve
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run tests
scripts.release:notes: vite build --ssr scripts/release-notes.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/release-notes --logLevel error && node node_modules/.cache/release-notes/release-notes.js
